lines.t: 5月至11月間，海拔2000公尺以下之地區有熱帶瘧及間日瘧感染風險。
lines.e: From May to November, there is a risk of falciparum malaria and vivax malaria in areas below 2000 metres above sea level.

lines.t: 建議前往前述風險區旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。
lines.e: Travellers going to the above risk areas are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites and to ask a doctor to assess whether oral preventive medicine is needed.

lines.t: 氯奎寧(chloroquine)
lines.e: Chloroquine

infants.t: 幼兒感染瘧疾可能會有嚴重併發症，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議，並採取適當防蚊措施。
infants.e: Malaria in young children may cause serious complications. Be sure to consult a doctor early for advice on preventive medicine, and take suitable measures against mosquito bites.

infants.t: 瘧疾預防用藥均需依照體重調整劑量，有些藥物有年齡或體重限制，不適合嬰幼兒使用，建議諮詢旅遊醫學門診醫師。
infants.e: The dose of all malaria prevention medicines must be adjusted by body weight, and some medicines have age or weight limits and are not suitable for infants and young children. We recommend consulting a travel medicine clinic doctor.

pregnancy.t: 孕婦感染瘧疾發生嚴重併發症機率較高，可選擇的瘧疾預防藥物也比較有限，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議。
pregnancy.e: Pregnant women who get malaria are more likely to have serious complications, and the malaria prevention medicines they can choose from are also more limited. Be sure to consult a doctor early for advice on preventive medicine.

pregnancy.t: 如果沒有適合的藥物可使用，建議暫緩前往高風險區。
pregnancy.e: If there is no suitable medicine available, we recommend postponing travel to high-risk areas.

immuno.t: 有些瘧疾預防藥物會和HIV藥物產生交互作用，目前已知會用交互作用的藥物如下：
immuno.e: Some malaria prevention medicines interact with HIV medicines. The medicines currently known to interact are as follows:

immuno.t: 美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外衛滋、易伐滋可能使此藥物的效果下降。
immuno.e: Mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; in addition, two other HIV medicines listed there may reduce the effect of this medicine.

immuno.t: 阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外可能和易伐滋產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; it may also interact with one other HIV medicine listed there.

immuno.t: 氯奎寧(Chloroquine)：可能和諾億亞產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Chloroquine: may interact with one HIV medicine (listed by its Taiwan brand name in the Chinese original).

immuno.t: 四環黴素(Doxycycline)：目前無已知交互作用。
immuno.e: Doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic): no interactions are currently known.

longstay.t: 居住於瘧疾高風險地區者，一般建議全程服用瘧疾預防藥物，如當地流行趨勢明顯，可與醫師討論僅於流行季節期間服用藥物。依目前用藥研究，美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)、阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)、四環黴素(Doxycycline)長期使用均不影響用藥效果，但請先諮詢醫師；但長期使用氯奎寧(chloroquine)，累積用量達100 g (約累計使用5年)可能造成視網膜毒性，應特別留意。
longstay.e: People who live in high-risk malaria areas are generally recommended to take malaria prevention medicine throughout; if the local epidemic trend is clear, they can discuss with a doctor taking the medicine only during the epidemic season. According to current research on the medicines, long-term use of mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione), atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone) and doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic) does not affect how well they work, but consult a doctor first. However, long-term use of chloroquine, with a cumulative dose of 100 g (about 5 years of use in total), may cause retinal toxicity, so take particular care.

longstay.t: 因孕婦、嬰幼兒的瘧疾預防用藥選擇有限，如計劃於居留當地期間受孕，請先諮詢醫師相關風險及預防方式。
longstay.e: Because the choice of malaria prevention medicine for pregnant women and infants and young children is limited, if you plan to conceive while staying there, consult a doctor first about the risks and ways of prevention.

lines.t: 自2013年起無本土病例通報，過去僅有間日瘧傳播之風險，於6月至10月間主要集中於庫拉河(Kura river)及阿拉斯河(Arax river)等低地地區。
lines.e: No local cases have been reported since 2013. In the past only vivax malaria was transmitted, mainly in lowland areas such as the Kura river and the Arax river between June and October.

lines.t: 建議至前述風險地區旅客採取防蚊措施。
lines.e: Travellers going to the above risk areas are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites.

lines.t: 首都巴庫市(Baku)無感染風險。
lines.e: There is no risk of infection in the capital, Baku.

lines.t: 全年皆有瘧疾感染風險,5月至10月為高風險月份，全國大部分地區無感染風險(包含達卡市Dhaka City)，且64個縣中僅13個縣具感染風險。
lines.e: There is a risk of malaria infection all year round, with May to October the high-risk months. Most of the country has no risk of infection (including Dhaka City), and only 13 of the 64 districts carry a risk of infection.

lines.t: 高風險地區(多位於該國東南部)：吉大港山區Chittagong Hill Tract districts(含Bandarban、 Rangamati、Khagrachari)，吉大港Chattogram District 以及科克斯巴扎爾Cox's Bazaar District。
lines.e: High-risk areas (mostly in the south-east of the country): Chittagong Hill Tract districts (including Bandarban, Rangamati, Khagrachari), Chattogram District and Cox's Bazaar District.

lines.t: 低風險地區(多位於該國東北部)：霍比甘傑Hobigonj、古里格拉姆Kurigram、毛爾維巴扎爾Moulvibazar、邁門辛Mymensingh、內德羅戈納Netrakona、謝爾布爾Sherpur、蘇納姆甘傑Sunamgonj以及錫爾赫特Sylhet。
lines.e: Low-risk areas (mostly in the north-east of the country): Hobigonj, Kurigram, Moulvibazar, Mymensingh, Netrakona, Sherpur, Sunamgonj and Sylhet.

lines.t: 建議前往前述風險區旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。
lines.e: Travellers going to the above risk areas are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites and to ask a doctor to assess whether oral preventive medicine is needed.

pregnancy.t: 孕婦感染瘧疾發生嚴重併發症機率較高，可選擇的瘧疾預防藥物也比較有限，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議。
pregnancy.e: Pregnant women who get malaria are more likely to have serious complications, and the malaria prevention medicines they can choose from are also more limited. Be sure to consult a doctor early for advice on preventive medicine.

pregnancy.t: 如果沒有適合的藥物可使用，建議暫緩前往高風險區。
pregnancy.e: If there is no suitable medicine available, we recommend postponing travel to high-risk areas.

immuno.t: 有些瘧疾預防藥物會和HIV藥物產生交互作用，目前已知會用交互作用的藥物如下：
immuno.e: Some malaria prevention medicines interact with HIV medicines. The medicines currently known to interact are as follows:

immuno.t: 美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外衛滋、易伐滋可能使此藥物的效果下降。
immuno.e: Mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; in addition, two other HIV medicines listed there may reduce the effect of this medicine.

immuno.t: 阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外可能和易伐滋產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; it may also interact with one other HIV medicine listed there.

immuno.t: 氯奎寧(Chloroquine)：可能和諾億亞產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Chloroquine: may interact with one HIV medicine (listed by its Taiwan brand name in the Chinese original).

immuno.t: 四環黴素(Doxycycline)：目前無已知交互作用。
immuno.e: Doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic): no interactions are currently known.

longstay.t: 居住於瘧疾高風險地區者，一般建議全程服用瘧疾預防藥物，如當地流行趨勢明顯，可與醫師討論僅於流行季節期間服用藥物。依目前用藥研究，美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)、阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)、四環黴素(Doxycycline)長期使用均不影響用藥效果，但請先諮詢醫師；但長期使用氯奎寧(chloroquine)，累積用量達100 g (約累計使用5年)可能造成視網膜毒性，應特別留意。
longstay.e: People who live in high-risk malaria areas are generally recommended to take malaria prevention medicine throughout; if the local epidemic trend is clear, they can discuss with a doctor taking the medicine only during the epidemic season. According to current research on the medicines, long-term use of mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione), atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone) and doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic) does not affect how well they work, but consult a doctor first. However, long-term use of chloroquine, with a cumulative dose of 100 g (about 5 years of use in total), may cause retinal toxicity, so take particular care.

longstay.t: 因孕婦、嬰幼兒的瘧疾預防用藥選擇有限，如計劃於居留當地期間受孕，請先諮詢醫師相關風險及預防方式。
longstay.e: Because the choice of malaria prevention medicine for pregnant women and infants and young children is limited, if you plan to conceive while staying there, consult a doctor first about the risks and ways of prevention.

lines.t: 全境且全年皆有熱帶瘧(惡性瘧)感染風險。
lines.e: There is a risk of falciparum (malignant) malaria throughout the country all year round.

lines.t: 建議旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。
lines.e: Travellers are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites and to ask a doctor to assess whether oral preventive medicine is needed.

lines.t: 氯奎寧(chloroquine)
lines.e: Chloroquine

longstay.e: Because the choice of malaria prevention medicine for pregnant women and infants and young children is limited, if you plan to conceive while staying there, consult a doctor first about the risks and ways of prevention.

lines.t: 全境且全年海拔低於2500公尺之地區都有感染風險(大部分為間日瘧)。在Beni省及Pando省感染風險最高，尤其Guayaramerin、Riberalta及Sena等地區。
lines.e: There is a risk of infection (mostly vivax malaria) throughout the country, all year round, in areas below 2500 metres above sea level. The risk is highest in Beni Province and Pando Province, especially the areas of Guayaramerin, Riberalta and Sena.

lines.t: 建議前往前述風險區旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。

immuno.t: 美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外衛滋、易伐滋可能使此藥物的效果下降。

immuno.t: 阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外可能和易伐滋產生交互作用。

lines.t: 風險集中於西北部、海拔900公尺以下的「亞馬遜雨林行政區」，包括Acre州、Amapá州、Amazonas州、Mato Grosso州北部、Pará州、Rondônia州、Roraima州及Maranhão州。前述地區以外雖風險極低，但仍有可能感染間日瘧、惡性瘧。
lines.e: The risk is concentrated in the north-western "Amazon rainforest administrative region" below 900 metres above sea level, which includes the states of Acre, Amapá, Amazonas, northern Mato Grosso, Pará, Rondônia, Roraima and Maranhão. Outside these areas the risk is extremely low, but infection with vivax malaria or falciparum malaria is still possible.

lines.t: 不丹南邊與印度交界的地區，有楚卡宗(Chukha)、達加納宗(Dagana)、佩馬加策爾宗(Pemagatshel)、薩姆德魯瓊卡爾宗 (Samdrup Jongkhar)、薩姆奇宗(Samtse)、蓋萊普宗(Sarpang)、謝姆岡宗(Zhemgang)，全年皆有瘧疾感染風險。
lines.e: In the southern areas of Bhutan bordering India, the dzongkhags (districts) of Chukha, Dagana, Pemagatshel, Samdrup Jongkhar, Samtse, Sarpang and Zhemgang have a risk of malaria infection all year round.

lines.t: 布姆唐宗(Bumthang)、加薩宗(Gasa)、帕羅宗(Paro)、廷布宗(Thimphu)則無染風險。
lines.e: The dzongkhags (districts) of Bumthang, Gasa, Paro and Thimphu have no risk of infection.

lines.t: 其餘地區於雨季月份有瘧疾感染風險。
lines.e: The remaining areas have a risk of malaria infection in the months of the rainy season.

longstay.t: 居住於瘧疾高風險地區者，一般建議全程服用瘧疾預防藥物，如當地流行趨勢明顯，可與醫師討論僅於流行季節期間服用藥物。依目前用藥研究，美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)、阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)、四環黴素(Doxycycline)長期使用均不影響用藥效果，但請先諮詢醫師；但長期使用氯奎寧(chloroquine)，累積用量達100 g (約累計使用5年)可能造成視網膜毒性，應特別留意。
longstay.e: People who live in high-risk malaria areas are generally recommended to take malaria prevention medicine throughout; if the local epidemic trend is clear, they can discuss with a doctor taking the medicine only during the epidemic season. According to current research on the medicines, long-term use of mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione), atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone) and doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic) does not affect how well they work, but consult a doctor first. However, long-term use of chloroquine, with a cumulative dose of 100 g (about 5 years of use in total), may cause retinal toxicity, so take particular care.

longstay.t: 因孕婦、嬰幼兒的瘧疾預防用藥選擇有限，如計劃於居留當地期間受孕，請先諮詢醫師相關風險及預防方式。
longstay.e: Because the choice of malaria prevention medicine for pregnant women and infants and young children is limited, if you plan to conceive while staying there, consult a doctor first about the risks and ways of prevention.

lines.t: 東部Stann Creek省的部分地區有感染風險。
lines.e: Parts of the eastern Stann Creek District have a risk of infection.

lines.t: 建議至前述風險地區旅客採取防蚊措施。
lines.e: Travellers going to the above risk areas are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites.

lines.t: 其他地區感染風險極低，可視為無風險，貝里斯市(Belize City)及旅客常造訪之島嶼則無感染風險。
lines.e: The risk of infection in other areas is extremely low and can be regarded as no risk; Belize City and the islands that travellers often visit have no risk of infection.

infants.t: 幼兒感染瘧疾可能會有嚴重併發症，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議，並採取適當防蚊措施。
infants.e: Malaria in young children may cause serious complications. Be sure to consult a doctor early for advice on preventive medicine, and take suitable measures against mosquito bites.

infants.t: 瘧疾預防用藥均需依照體重調整劑量，有些藥物有年齡或體重限制，不適合嬰幼兒使用，建議諮詢旅遊醫學門診醫師。
infants.e: The dose of all malaria prevention medicines must be adjusted by body weight, and some medicines have age or weight limits and are not suitable for infants and young children. We recommend consulting a travel medicine clinic doctor.

pregnancy.t: 孕婦感染瘧疾發生嚴重併發症機率較高，可選擇的瘧疾預防藥物也比較有限，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議。
pregnancy.e: Pregnant women who get malaria are more likely to have serious complications, and the malaria prevention medicines they can choose from are also more limited. Be sure to consult a doctor early for advice on preventive medicine.

pregnancy.t: 如果沒有適合的藥物可使用，建議暫緩前往高風險區。
pregnancy.e: If there is no suitable medicine available, we recommend postponing travel to high-risk areas.

immuno.t: 有些瘧疾預防藥物會和HIV藥物產生交互作用，目前已知會用交互作用的藥物如下：
immuno.e: Some malaria prevention medicines interact with HIV medicines. The medicines currently known to interact are as follows:

immuno.t: 美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外衛滋、易伐滋可能使此藥物的效果下降。
immuno.e: Mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; in addition, two other HIV medicines listed there may reduce the effect of this medicine.

immuno.t: 阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外可能和易伐滋產生交互作用。

immuno.t: 氯奎寧(Chloroquine)：可能和諾億亞產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Chloroquine: may interact with one HIV medicine (listed by its Taiwan brand name in the Chinese original).

immuno.t: 四環黴素(Doxycycline)：目前無已知交互作用。
immuno.e: Doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic): no interactions are currently known.

lines.t: 全境且全年皆有熱帶瘧(惡性瘧)感染風險。
lines.e: There is a risk of falciparum (malignant) malaria throughout the country all year round.

lines.t: 建議旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。

infants.t: 幼兒感染瘧疾可能會有嚴重併發症，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議，並採取適當防蚊措施。
infants.e: Malaria in young children may cause serious complications. Be sure to consult a doctor early for advice on preventive medicine, and take suitable measures against mosquito bites.

infants.t: 瘧疾預防用藥均需依照體重調整劑量，有些藥物有年齡或體重限制，不適合嬰幼兒使用，建議諮詢旅遊醫學門診醫師。
infants.e: The dose of all malaria prevention medicines must be adjusted by body weight, and some medicines have age or weight limits and are not suitable for infants and young children. We recommend consulting a travel medicine clinic doctor.

pregnancy.t: 孕婦感染瘧疾發生嚴重併發症機率較高，可選擇的瘧疾預防藥物也比較有限，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議。
pregnancy.e: Pregnant women who get malaria are more likely to have serious complications, and the malaria prevention medicines they can choose from are also more limited. Be sure to consult a doctor early for advice on preventive medicine.

pregnancy.t: 如果沒有適合的藥物可使用，建議暫緩前往高風險區。
pregnancy.e: If there is no suitable medicine available, we recommend postponing travel to high-risk areas.

immuno.t: 有些瘧疾預防藥物會和HIV藥物產生交互作用，目前已知會用交互作用的藥物如下：
immuno.e: Some malaria prevention medicines interact with HIV medicines. The medicines currently known to interact are as follows:

immuno.t: 美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外衛滋、易伐滋可能使此藥物的效果下降。
immuno.e: Mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; in addition, two other HIV medicines listed there may reduce the effect of this medicine.

immuno.t: 阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外可能和易伐滋產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; it may also interact with one other HIV medicine listed there.

immuno.t: 氯奎寧(Chloroquine)：可能和諾億亞產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Chloroquine: may interact with one HIV medicine (listed by its Taiwan brand name in the Chinese original).

immuno.t: 四環黴素(Doxycycline)：目前無已知交互作用。
immuno.e: Doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic): no interactions are currently known.

longstay.t: 居住於瘧疾高風險地區者，一般建議全程服用瘧疾預防藥物，如當地流行趨勢明顯，可與醫師討論僅於流行季節期間服用藥物。依目前用藥研究，美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)、阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)、四環黴素(Doxycycline)長期使用均不影響用藥效果，但請先諮詢醫師；但長期使用氯奎寧(chloroquine)，累積用量達100 g (約累計使用5年)可能造成視網膜毒性，應特別留意。
longstay.e: People who live in high-risk malaria areas are generally recommended to take malaria prevention medicine throughout; if the local epidemic trend is clear, they can discuss with a doctor taking the medicine only during the epidemic season. According to current research on the medicines, long-term use of mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione), atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone) and doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic) does not affect how well they work, but consult a doctor first. However, long-term use of chloroquine, with a cumulative dose of 100 g (about 5 years of use in total), may cause retinal toxicity, so take particular care.

longstay.t: 因孕婦、嬰幼兒的瘧疾預防用藥選擇有限，如計劃於居留當地期間受孕，請先諮詢醫師相關風險及預防方式。
longstay.e: Because the choice of malaria prevention medicine for pregnant women and infants and young children is limited, if you plan to conceive while staying there, consult a doctor first about the risks and ways of prevention.

lines.t: 全境且全年皆有熱帶瘧(惡性瘧)感染風險。
lines.e: There is a risk of falciparum (malignant) malaria throughout the country all year round.

lines.t: 建議旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。
lines.e: Travellers are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites and to ask a doctor to assess whether oral preventive medicine is needed.

lines.e: No local cases have been reported since 2017.

lines.t: 海拔1700公尺以下的地區皆有感染風險，不包括首都Bogotá、Cartagena城以及Medellin城。
lines.e: There is a risk of infection in all areas below 1700 metres above sea level, except the capital Bogotá, the city of Cartagena and the city of Medellin.

lines.t: 建議前往前述風險區旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。

infants.t: 幼兒感染瘧疾可能會有嚴重併發症，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議，並採取適當防蚊措施。
infants.e: Malaria in young children may cause serious complications. Be sure to consult a doctor early for advice on preventive medicine, and take suitable measures against mosquito bites.

infants.t: 瘧疾預防用藥均需依照體重調整劑量，有些藥物有年齡或體重限制，不適合嬰幼兒使用，建議諮詢旅遊醫學門診醫師。
infants.e: The dose of all malaria prevention medicines must be adjusted by body weight, and some medicines have age or weight limits and are not suitable for infants and young children. We recommend consulting a travel medicine clinic doctor.

pregnancy.t: 孕婦感染瘧疾發生嚴重併發症機率較高，可選擇的瘧疾預防藥物也比較有限，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議。
pregnancy.e: Pregnant women who get malaria are more likely to have serious complications, and the malaria prevention medicines they can choose from are also more limited. Be sure to consult a doctor early for advice on preventive medicine.

pregnancy.t: 如果沒有適合的藥物可使用，建議暫緩前往高風險區。
pregnancy.e: If there is no suitable medicine available, we recommend postponing travel to high-risk areas.

immuno.t: 有些瘧疾預防藥物會和HIV藥物產生交互作用，目前已知會用交互作用的藥物如下：
immuno.e: Some malaria prevention medicines interact with HIV medicines. The medicines currently known to interact are as follows:

immuno.t: 美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外衛滋、易伐滋可能使此藥物的效果下降。
immuno.e: Mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; in addition, two other HIV medicines listed there may reduce the effect of this medicine.

immuno.t: 阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外可能和易伐滋產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; it may also interact with one other HIV medicine listed there.

immuno.t: 氯奎寧(Chloroquine)：可能和諾億亞產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Chloroquine: may interact with one HIV medicine (listed by its Taiwan brand name in the Chinese original).

immuno.t: 四環黴素(Doxycycline)：目前無已知交互作用。
immuno.e: Doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic): no interactions are currently known.

longstay.t: 居住於瘧疾高風險地區者，一般建議全程服用瘧疾預防藥物，如當地流行趨勢明顯，可與醫師討論僅於流行季節期間服用藥物。依目前用藥研究，美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)、阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)、四環黴素(Doxycycline)長期使用均不影響用藥效果，但請先諮詢醫師；但長期使用氯奎寧(chloroquine)，累積用量達100 g (約累計使用5年)可能造成視網膜毒性，應特別留意。
longstay.e: People who live in high-risk malaria areas are generally recommended to take malaria prevention medicine throughout; if the local epidemic trend is clear, they can discuss with a doctor taking the medicine only during the epidemic season. According to current research on the medicines, long-term use of mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione), atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone) and doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic) does not affect how well they work, but consult a doctor first. However, long-term use of chloroquine, with a cumulative dose of 100 g (about 5 years of use in total), may cause retinal toxicity, so take particular care.

longstay.t: 因孕婦、嬰幼兒的瘧疾預防用藥選擇有限，如計劃於居留當地期間受孕，請先諮詢醫師相關風險及預防方式。
longstay.e: Because the choice of malaria prevention medicine for pregnant women and infants and young children is limited, if you plan to conceive while staying there, consult a doctor first about the risks and ways of prevention.

lines.t: 除首都基多市(Quito)、Guayaquil市及龜島群島(Galapagos)無感染風險外，全境海拔低於1500公尺地區皆有感染風險，西部沿海省份風險較高，尤其西北部Esmeraldas省有較多熱帶瘧(惡性瘧)感染病例。
lines.e: Except for the capital Quito, the city of Guayaquil and the Galapagos Islands, which have no risk of infection, all areas below 1500 metres above sea level have a risk of infection. The risk is higher in the western coastal provinces, and especially in Esmeraldas Province in the north-west there are more cases of falciparum (malignant) malaria infection.

lines.t: 建議前往前述風險區旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。
lines.e: Travellers going to the above risk areas are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites and to ask a doctor to assess whether oral preventive medicine is needed.

lines.t: 自1998年起無本土病例通報，但法尤姆(El Faiyûm Governorate)於6到10月間，仍有極低的熱帶瘧(惡性瘧)與間日瘧暴露風險。
lines.e: No local cases have been reported since 1998, but from June to October there is still an extremely low risk of exposure to falciparum (malignant) malaria and vivax malaria in El Faiyûm Governorate.

immuno.t: 美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外衛滋、易伐滋可能使此藥物的效果下降。
immuno.e: Mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; in addition, two other HIV medicines listed there may reduce the effect of this medicine.

immuno.t: 阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外可能和易伐滋產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; it may also interact with one other HIV medicine listed there.

immuno.t: 氯奎寧(Chloroquine)：可能和諾億亞產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Chloroquine: may interact with one HIV medicine (listed by its Taiwan brand name in the Chinese original).

immuno.t: 四環黴素(Doxycycline)：目前無已知交互作用。
immuno.e: Doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic): no interactions are currently known.

longstay.t: 居住於瘧疾高風險地區者，一般建議全程服用瘧疾預防藥物，如當地流行趨勢明顯，可與醫師討論僅於流行季節期間服用藥物。依目前用藥研究，美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)、阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)、四環黴素(Doxycycline)長期使用均不影響用藥效果，但請先諮詢醫師；但長期使用氯奎寧(chloroquine)，累積用量達100 g (約累計使用5年)可能造成視網膜毒性，應特別留意。
longstay.e: People who live in high-risk malaria areas are generally recommended to take malaria prevention medicine throughout; if the local epidemic trend is clear, they can discuss with a doctor taking the medicine only during the epidemic season. According to current research on the medicines, long-term use of mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione), atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone) and doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic) does not affect how well they work, but consult a doctor first. However, long-term use of chloroquine, with a cumulative dose of 100 g (about 5 years of use in total), may cause retinal toxicity, so take particular care.

longstay.t: 因孕婦、嬰幼兒的瘧疾預防用藥選擇有限，如計劃於居留當地期間受孕，請先諮詢醫師相關風險及預防方式。
longstay.e: Because the choice of malaria prevention medicine for pregnant women and infants and young children is limited, if you plan to conceive while staying there, consult a doctor first about the risks and ways of prevention.

lines.t: 除首都Addis Ababa外，全境低於2000公尺以下地區均有感染風險。
lines.e: Except for the capital Addis Ababa, all areas below 2000 metres above sea level have a risk of infection.

lines.t: 建議前往前述風險區旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。
lines.e: Travellers going to the above risk areas are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites and to ask a doctor to assess whether oral preventive medicine is needed.

lines.t: 氯奎寧(chloroquine)，有通報間日瘧chloroquine抗藥性。
lines.e: Chloroquine, with chloroquine resistance reported in vivax malaria.

pregnancy.t: 孕婦感染瘧疾發生嚴重併發症機率較高，可選擇的瘧疾預防藥物也比較有限，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議。

pregnancy.t: 如果沒有適合的藥物可使用，建議暫緩前往高風險區。

lines.e: The risk of falciparum (malignant) malaria and vivax malaria infection is high all year round, especially in the administrative districts bordering Brazil (Oiapoque valley) and Suriname (Maroni valley); the risk in other areas is extremely low. Cases of multidrug-resistant falciparum (malignant) malaria have been reported in areas affected by migration from Brazil.

infants.t: 瘧疾預防用藥均需依照體重調整劑量，有些藥物有年齡或體重限制，不適合嬰幼兒使用，建議諮詢旅遊醫學門診醫師。
infants.e: The dose of all malaria prevention medicines must be adjusted by body weight, and some medicines have age or weight limits and are not suitable for infants and young children. We recommend consulting a travel medicine clinic doctor.

pregnancy.t: 孕婦感染瘧疾發生嚴重併發症機率較高，可選擇的瘧疾預防藥物也比較有限，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議。

pregnancy.t: 如果沒有適合的藥物可使用，建議暫緩前往高風險區。
pregnancy.e: If there is no suitable medicine available, we recommend postponing travel to high-risk areas.

immuno.t: 有些瘧疾預防藥物會和HIV藥物產生交互作用，目前已知會用交互作用的藥物如下：
immuno.e: Some malaria prevention medicines interact with HIV medicines. The medicines currently known to interact are as follows:

immuno.t: 美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外衛滋、易伐滋可能使此藥物的效果下降。
immuno.e: Mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; in addition, two other HIV medicines listed there may reduce the effect of this medicine.

immuno.t: 阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外可能和易伐滋產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; it may also interact with one other HIV medicine listed there.

immuno.t: 氯奎寧(Chloroquine)：可能和諾億亞產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Chloroquine: may interact with one HIV medicine (listed by its Taiwan brand name in the Chinese original).

immuno.t: 四環黴素(Doxycycline)：目前無已知交互作用。
immuno.e: Doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic): no interactions are currently known.

longstay.t: 居住於瘧疾高風險地區者，一般建議全程服用瘧疾預防藥物，如當地流行趨勢明顯，可與醫師討論僅於流行季節期間服用藥物。依目前用藥研究，美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)、阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)、四環黴素(Doxycycline)長期使用均不影響用藥效果，但請先諮詢醫師；但長期使用氯奎寧(chloroquine)，累積用量達100 g (約累計使用5年)可能造成視網膜毒性，應特別留意。
longstay.e: People who live in high-risk malaria areas are generally recommended to take malaria prevention medicine throughout; if the local epidemic trend is clear, they can discuss with a doctor taking the medicine only during the epidemic season. According to current research on the medicines, long-term use of mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione), atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone) and doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic) does not affect how well they work, but consult a doctor first. However, long-term use of chloroquine, with a cumulative dose of 100 g (about 5 years of use in total), may cause retinal toxicity, so take particular care.

longstay.t: 因孕婦、嬰幼兒的瘧疾預防用藥選擇有限，如計劃於居留當地期間受孕，請先諮詢醫師相關風險及預防方式。
longstay.e: Because the choice of malaria prevention medicine for pregnant women and infants and young children is limited, if you plan to conceive while staying there, consult a doctor first about the risks and ways of prevention.

GS.en: South George and South Sandwich Islands

lines.t: 僅海拔1500公尺以下的鄉村地區有感染風險(間日瘧為主)，不包含首都瓜地馬拉市(Guatemala City)、安地卡市(Antigua)、亞特蘭湖(Lake Atitlán)。
lines.e: Only rural areas below 1500 metres above sea level have a risk of infection (mainly vivax malaria); this does not include the capital Guatemala City, Antigua or Lake Atitlán.

lines.t: 建議前往前述風險區旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。
lines.e: Travellers going to the above risk areas are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites and to ask a doctor to assess whether oral preventive medicine is needed.

immuno.t: 美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外衛滋、易伐滋可能使此藥物的效果下降。
immuno.e: Mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; in addition, two other HIV medicines listed there may reduce the effect of this medicine.

immuno.t: 阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外可能和易伐滋產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; it may also interact with one other HIV medicine listed there.

immuno.t: 氯奎寧(Chloroquine)：可能和諾億亞產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Chloroquine: may interact with one HIV medicine (listed by its Taiwan brand name in the Chinese original).

immuno.t: 四環黴素(Doxycycline)：目前無已知交互作用。
immuno.e: Doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic): no interactions are currently known.

longstay.t: 居住於瘧疾高風險地區者，一般建議全程服用瘧疾預防藥物，如當地流行趨勢明顯，可與醫師討論僅於流行季節期間服用藥物。依目前用藥研究，美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)、阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)、四環黴素(Doxycycline)長期使用均不影響用藥效果，但請先諮詢醫師；但長期使用氯奎寧(chloroquine)，累積用量達100 g (約累計使用5年)可能造成視網膜毒性，應特別留意。
longstay.e: People who live in high-risk malaria areas are generally recommended to take malaria prevention medicine throughout; if the local epidemic trend is clear, they can discuss with a doctor taking the medicine only during the epidemic season. According to current research on the medicines, long-term use of mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione), atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone) and doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic) does not affect how well they work, but consult a doctor first. However, long-term use of chloroquine, with a cumulative dose of 100 g (about 5 years of use in total), may cause retinal toxicity, so take particular care.

longstay.t: 因孕婦、嬰幼兒的瘧疾預防用藥選擇有限，如計劃於居留當地期間受孕，請先諮詢醫師相關風險及預防方式。
longstay.e: Because the choice of malaria prevention medicine for pregnant women and infants and young children is limited, if you plan to conceive while staying there, consult a doctor first about the risks and ways of prevention.

lines.t: 全境且全年皆有熱帶瘧(惡性瘧)感染風險，尤其是大灣省(Grand'Anse)、尼普斯省(Nippes)及東南省(Sud-Est)。
lines.e: There is a risk of falciparum (malignant) malaria infection throughout the country all year round, especially in Grand'Anse, Nippes and Sud-Est provinces.

lines.t: 建議旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。
lines.e: Travellers are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites and to ask a doctor to assess whether oral preventive medicine is needed.

lines.t: 無
lines.e: None

infants.t: 幼兒感染瘧疾可能會有嚴重併發症，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議，並採取適當防蚊措施。
infants.e: Malaria in young children may cause serious complications. Be sure to consult a doctor early for advice on preventive medicine, and take suitable measures against mosquito bites.

infants.t: 瘧疾預防用藥均需依照體重調整劑量，有些藥物有年齡或體重限制，不適合嬰幼兒使用，建議諮詢旅遊醫學門診醫師。
infants.e: The dose of all malaria prevention medicines must be adjusted by body weight, and some medicines have age or weight limits and are not suitable for infants and young children. We recommend consulting a travel medicine clinic doctor.

pregnancy.t: 孕婦感染瘧疾發生嚴重併發症機率較高，可選擇的瘧疾預防藥物也比較有限，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議。
pregnancy.e: Pregnant women who get malaria are more likely to have serious complications, and the malaria prevention medicines they can choose from are also more limited. Be sure to consult a doctor early for advice on preventive medicine.

pregnancy.t: 如果沒有適合的藥物可使用，建議暫緩前往高風險區。
pregnancy.e: If there is no suitable medicine available, we recommend postponing travel to high-risk areas.

lines.t: 除了市區、觀光景點及渡假村除外，東部省份(East Nusa Tenggara、Maluku、North Maluku、Papua、West Papua)全年有感染風險；其他省份的感染風險則較侷限部分區域；雅加達、觀光景點及渡假村無感染風險。另，於Kalimantan省有諾氏瘧原蟲(P. knowlesi)感染通報。
lines.e: Except for urban areas, tourist sites and resorts, the eastern provinces (East Nusa Tenggara, Maluku, North Maluku, Papua, West Papua) have a risk of infection all year round; in the other provinces the risk of infection is limited to certain areas; Jakarta, tourist sites and resorts have no risk of infection. In addition, infection with Plasmodium knowlesi (P. knowlesi) has been reported in Kalimantan Province.

lines.t: 建議前往前述風險區旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。
lines.e: Travellers going to the above risk areas are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites and to ask a doctor to assess whether oral preventive medicine is needed.

lines.t: 全境均有熱帶瘧(惡性瘧)與間日瘧感染風險，包含孟買和德里市區。海拔高於2000公尺地區—喜馬偕爾邦(Himachal Pradesh)、查謨-克什米爾邦(Jammu and Kashmir)與錫金邦(Sikkim)，感染風險較低。
lines.e: There is a risk of falciparum (malignant) malaria and vivax malaria infection throughout the country, including the urban areas of Mumbai and Delhi. Areas above 2000 metres above sea level (Himachal Pradesh, Jammu and Kashmir, and Sikkim) have a lower risk of infection.

longstay.t: 居住於瘧疾高風險地區者，一般建議全程服用瘧疾預防藥物，如當地流行趨勢明顯，可與醫師討論僅於流行季節期間服用藥物。依目前用藥研究，美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)、阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)、四環黴素(Doxycycline)長期使用均不影響用藥效果，但請先諮詢醫師；但長期使用氯奎寧(chloroquine)，累積用量達100 g (約累計使用5年)可能造成視網膜毒性，應特別留意。
longstay.e: People who live in high-risk malaria areas are generally recommended to take malaria prevention medicine throughout; if the local epidemic trend is clear, they can discuss with a doctor taking the medicine only during the epidemic season. According to current research on the medicines, long-term use of mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione), atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone) and doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic) does not affect how well they work, but consult a doctor first. longstay.t: 因孕婦、嬰幼兒的瘧疾預防用藥選擇有限，如計劃於居留當地期間受孕，請先諮詢醫師相關風險及預防方式。
longstay.e: Because the choice of malaria prevention medicine for pregnant women and infants and young children is limited, if you plan to conceive while staying there, consult a doctor first about the risks and ways of prevention.

lines.t: 3月至11月間，伊朗東南部(Hormozgan省、Kerman省南部、Sistan and Baluchestan省南部)的鄉村地區有感染風險。
lines.e: From March to November, rural areas of south-eastern Iran (Hormozgan Province, southern Kerman Province, southern Sistan and Baluchestan Province) have a risk of infection.

lines.t: 建議前往前述風險區旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。
lines.e: Travellers going to the above risk areas are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites and to ask a doctor to assess whether oral preventive medicine is needed.

pregnancy.t: 孕婦感染瘧疾發生嚴重併發症機率較高，可選擇的瘧疾預防藥物也比較有限，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議。

pregnancy.t: 如果沒有適合的藥物可使用，建議暫緩前往高風險區。

lines.t: 2011-2013年間無本土病例，但6月到10月間，西部與烏茲別克、塔吉克交界省份、首都比什凱克(Bishkek)市郊仍有低度暴露風險。
lines.e: There were no local cases in 2011–2013, but from June to October there is still a low risk of exposure in the western provinces bordering Uzbekistan and Tajikistan and in the suburbs of the capital Bishkek.

lines.t: 吳哥窟周邊地區與首都金邊市(Phnom Penh)無感染風險；暹粒(Siem Reap)與洞里薩湖(Tonle Sap)周邊地區感染風險較低。
lines.e: The area around Angkor Wat and the capital Phnom Penh have no risk of infection; the risk of infection around Siem Reap and Tonle Sap is lower.

lines.t: 市郊及鄉村的森林地區全年皆有感染熱帶瘧(惡性瘧)及間日瘧的風險。
lines.e: Forested areas in the suburbs and countryside have a risk of falciparum (malignant) malaria and vivax malaria infection all year round.

lines.t: 建議前往前述風險區旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。

lines.t: chloroquine、mefloquine、artesunate、lumefantrine、piperaquine 已從西部擴張至中部地區；東部地區已有間日瘧對chloroquine具抗藥性報告。
lines.e: Resistance to chloroquine, mefloquine, artesunate, lumefantrine and piperaquine has spread from the west to the central area; vivax malaria resistant to chloroquine has been reported in the eastern area.

longstay.e: Because the choice of malaria prevention medicine for pregnant women and infants and young children is limited, if you plan to conceive while staying there, consult a doctor first about the risks and ways of prevention.

immuno.e: Chloroquine: may interact with one HIV medicine (listed by its Taiwan brand name in the Chinese original).

immuno.t: 四環黴素(Doxycycline)：目前無已知交互作用。

immuno.t: 有些瘧疾預防藥物會和HIV藥物產生交互作用，目前已知會用交互作用的藥物如下：
immuno.e: Some malaria prevention medicines interact with HIV medicines. The medicines currently known to interact are as follows:

immuno.t: 美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外衛滋、易伐滋可能使此藥物的效果下降。
immuno.e: Mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; in addition, two other HIV medicines listed there may reduce the effect of this medicine.

immuno.t: 阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外可能和易伐滋產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; it may also interact with one other HIV medicine listed there.

immuno.t: 氯奎寧(Chloroquine)：可能和諾億亞產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Chloroquine: may interact with one HIV medicine (listed by its Taiwan brand name in the Chinese original).

immuno.t: 四環黴素(Doxycycline)：目前無已知交互作用。
immuno.e: Doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic): no interactions are currently known.

longstay.t: 居住於瘧疾高風險地區者，一般建議全程服用瘧疾預防藥物，如當地流行趨勢明顯，可與醫師討論僅於流行季節期間服用藥物。依目前用藥研究，美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)、阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)、四環黴素(Doxycycline)長期使用均不影響用藥效果，但請先諮詢醫師；但長期使用氯奎寧(chloroquine)，累積用量達100 g (約累計使用5年)可能造成視網膜毒性，應特別留意。
longstay.e: People who live in high-risk malaria areas are generally recommended to take malaria prevention medicine throughout; if the local epidemic trend is clear, they can discuss with a doctor taking the medicine only during the epidemic season. According to current research on the medicines, long-term use of mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione), atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone) and doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic) does not affect how well they work, but consult a doctor first. However, long-term use of chloroquine, with a cumulative dose of 100 g (about 5 years of use in total), may cause retinal toxicity, so take particular care.

longstay.t: 因孕婦、嬰幼兒的瘧疾預防用藥選擇有限，如計劃於居留當地期間受孕，請先諮詢醫師相關風險及預防方式。
longstay.e: Because the choice of malaria prevention medicine for pregnant women and infants and young children is limited, if you plan to conceive while staying there, consult a doctor first about the risks and ways of prevention.

lines.t: 偏遠農村、丘陵、森林地區全年有感染熱帶瘧(惡性瘧)風險，Rakhine State部分沿海地區亦有感染風險；中部平原地區與乾燥地區通常無感染風險，但仍可能散發傳播；過去曾通報諾氏瘧原蟲(P. knowlesi)病例。
lines.e: Remote rural, hilly and forested areas have a risk of falciparum (malignant) malaria infection all year round, and some coastal areas of Rakhine State also have a risk of infection; the central plains and dry areas usually have no risk of infection, but sporadic transmission is still possible; cases of Plasmodium knowlesi (P. knowlesi) have been reported in the past.

lines.t: 建議前往前述風險區旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。
lines.e: Travellers going to the above risk areas are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites and to ask a doctor to assess whether oral preventive medicine is needed.

lines.t: 瘧原蟲抗藥性：
lines.e: Malaria parasite drug resistance:

lines.t: 克倫邦(Kayin State)以及撣邦(Shan state)東半部有美爾奎寧(mefloquine)抗藥性。
lines.e: There is mefloquine resistance in Kayin State and the eastern half of Shan State.

lines.t: 國家東南部地區疑似出現新興青蒿素抗藥性(emerging artemisinin resistance)。
lines.e: Emerging artemisinin resistance (emerging artemisinin resistance) is suspected in the south-eastern part of the country.

lines.t: 氯奎寧(chloroquine)，已有間日瘧對chloroquine具抗藥性報告。
lines.e: Chloroquine, with chloroquine resistance reported in vivax malaria.

pregnancy.t: 如果沒有適合的藥物可使用，建議暫緩前往高風險區。
pregnancy.e: If there is no suitable medicine available, we recommend postponing travel to high-risk areas.

immuno.t: 有些瘧疾預防藥物會和HIV藥物產生交互作用，目前已知會用交互作用的藥物如下：
immuno.e: Some malaria prevention medicines interact with HIV medicines. The medicines currently known to interact are as follows:

immuno.t: 美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外衛滋、易伐滋可能使此藥物的效果下降。
immuno.e: Mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; in addition, two other HIV medicines listed there may reduce the effect of this medicine.

immuno.t: 阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外可能和易伐滋產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; it may also interact with one other HIV medicine listed there.

immuno.t: 氯奎寧(Chloroquine)：可能和諾億亞產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Chloroquine: may interact with one HIV medicine (listed by its Taiwan brand name in the Chinese original).

immuno.t: 四環黴素(Doxycycline)：目前無已知交互作用。
immuno.e: Doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic): no interactions are currently known.

longstay.t: 居住於瘧疾高風險地區者，一般建議全程服用瘧疾預防藥物，如當地流行趨勢明顯，可與醫師討論僅於流行季節期間服用藥物。依目前用藥研究，美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)、阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)、四環黴素(Doxycycline)長期使用均不影響用藥效果，但請先諮詢醫師；但長期使用氯奎寧(chloroquine)，累積用量達100 g (約累計使用5年)可能造成視網膜毒性，應特別留意。
longstay.e: People who live in high-risk malaria areas are generally recommended to take malaria prevention medicine throughout; if the local epidemic trend is clear, they can discuss with a doctor taking the medicine only during the epidemic season. According to current research on the medicines, long-term use of mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione), atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone) and doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic) does not affect how well they work, but consult a doctor first. However, long-term use of chloroquine, with a cumulative dose of 100 g (about 5 years of use in total), may cause retinal toxicity, so take particular care.

longstay.t: 因孕婦、嬰幼兒的瘧疾預防用藥選擇有限，如計劃於居留當地期間受孕，請先諮詢醫師相關風險及預防方式。
longstay.e: Because the choice of malaria prevention medicine for pregnant women and infants and young children is limited, if you plan to conceive while staying there, consult a doctor first about the risks and ways of prevention.

lines.t: 除了Dakhlet-Nouadhibou省與Tiris-Zemour省，全境且全年皆具熱帶瘧(惡性瘧)感染風險。
lines.e: Except for Dakhlet-Nouadhibou Province and Tiris-Zemour Province, there is a risk of falciparum (malignant) malaria infection throughout the country all year round.

lines.t: 在Adrar省和Inchiri省則於雨季(七月至十月)具感染風險。
lines.e: Adrar Province and Inchiri Province have a risk of infection in the rainy season (July to October).

lines.t: 建議前往前述風險區旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。
lines.e: Travellers going to the above risk areas are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites and to ask a doctor to assess whether oral preventive medicine is needed.

lines.t: 氯奎寧(chloroquine)
lines.e: Chloroquine

infants.t: 幼兒感染瘧疾可能會有嚴重併發症，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議，並採取適當防蚊措施。
infants.e: Malaria in young children may cause serious complications. Be sure to consult a doctor early for advice on preventive medicine, and take suitable measures against mosquito bites.

infants.t: 瘧疾預防用藥均需依照體重調整劑量，有些藥物有年齡或體重限制，不適合嬰幼兒使用，建議諮詢旅遊醫學門診醫師。
infants.e: The dose of all malaria prevention medicines must be adjusted by body weight, and some medicines have age or weight limits and are not suitable for infants and young children. We recommend consulting a travel medicine clinic doctor.

lines.t: 觀光客不常造訪的鄉村地區有間日瘧感染風險，Campeche、Chiapas、Chihuahua、Sinaloa等地區有感染風險，美墨邊界無感染風險。
lines.e: Rural areas that tourists seldom visit have a risk of vivax malaria infection. Areas such as Campeche, Chiapas, Chihuahua and Sinaloa have a risk of infection, and the US–Mexico border has no risk of infection.

lines.t: 市區、都市近郊及沿海地區無感染風險，感染風險侷限在沙巴內陸地區、沙勞越內陸地區及馬來半島中部地區。2021年無惡性瘧(P. falciparum)本土病例。過去曾通報諾氏瘧原蟲(P.knowlesi)病例。
lines.e: Urban areas, urban outskirts and coastal areas have no risk of infection; the risk of infection is limited to inland Sabah, inland Sarawak and the central part of the Malay Peninsula. There were no local cases of P. falciparum in 2021. Cases of Plasmodium knowlesi (P.knowlesi) have been reported in the past.

immuno.t: 阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外可能和易伐滋產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; it may also interact with one other HIV medicine listed there.

immuno.t: 氯奎寧(Chloroquine)：可能和諾億亞產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Chloroquine: may interact with one HIV medicine (listed by its Taiwan brand name in the Chinese original).

immuno.t: 四環黴素(Doxycycline)：目前無已知交互作用。
immuno.e: Doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic): no interactions are currently known.

longstay.t: 居住於瘧疾高風險地區者，一般建議全程服用瘧疾預防藥物，如當地流行趨勢明顯，可與醫師討論僅於流行季節期間服用藥物。依目前用藥研究，美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)、阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)、四環黴素(Doxycycline)長期使用均不影響用藥效果，但請先諮詢醫師；但長期使用氯奎寧(chloroquine)，累積用量達100 g (約累計使用5年)可能造成視網膜毒性，應特別留意。
longstay.e: People who live in high-risk malaria areas are generally recommended to take malaria prevention medicine throughout; if the local epidemic trend is clear, they can discuss with a doctor taking the medicine only during the epidemic season. According to current research on the medicines, long-term use of mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione), atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone) and doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic) does not affect how well they work, but consult a doctor first. However, long-term use of chloroquine, with a cumulative dose of 100 g (about 5 years of use in total), may cause retinal toxicity, so take particular care.

longstay.t: 因孕婦、嬰幼兒的瘧疾預防用藥選擇有限，如計劃於居留當地期間受孕，請先諮詢醫師相關風險及預防方式。
longstay.e: Because the choice of malaria prevention medicine for pregnant women and infants and young children is limited, if you plan to conceive while staying there, consult a doctor first about the risks and ways of prevention.

lines.t: 全境且全年皆有熱帶瘧(惡性瘧)感染風險。
lines.e: There is a risk of falciparum (malignant) malaria throughout the country all year round.

lines.t: 建議旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。
lines.e: Travellers are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites and to ask a doctor to assess whether oral preventive medicine is needed.

lines.t: 氯奎寧(chloroquine)
lines.e: Chloroquine

infants.t: 幼兒感染瘧疾可能會有嚴重併發症，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議，並採取適當防蚊措施。
infants.e: Malaria in young children may cause serious complications. Be sure to consult a doctor early for advice on preventive medicine, and take suitable measures against mosquito bites.

infants.t: 瘧疾預防用藥均需依照體重調整劑量，有些藥物有年齡或體重限制，不適合嬰幼兒使用，建議諮詢旅遊醫學門診醫師。
infants.e: The dose of all malaria prevention medicines must be adjusted by body weight, and some medicines have age or weight limits and are not suitable for infants and young children. We recommend consulting a travel medicine clinic doctor.

pregnancy.t: 孕婦感染瘧疾發生嚴重併發症機率較高，可選擇的瘧疾預防藥物也比較有限，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議。
pregnancy.e: Pregnant women who get malaria are more likely to have serious complications, and the malaria prevention medicines they can choose from are also more limited. Be sure to consult a doctor early for advice on preventive medicine.

pregnancy.t: 如果沒有適合的藥物可使用，建議暫緩前往高風險區。
pregnancy.e: If there is no suitable medicine available, we recommend postponing travel to high-risk areas.

lines.t: Ohangwena、Omaheke、Omusati、Oshana、Oshikoto以及Otjozondjupa地區於11月到隔年6月間有感染熱帶瘧(惡性瘧)風險。另，Kunene行政區Kunene river、Zambezi行政區Zambezi流域以及Kavango行政區Okavango河西部和東部流域，則全年均有感染熱帶瘧(惡性瘧)風險。
lines.e: The areas of Ohangwena, Omaheke, Omusati, Oshana, Oshikoto and Otjozondjupa have a risk of falciparum (malignant) malaria infection from November to June of the following year. In addition, the Kunene river in Kunene Region, the Zambezi basin in Zambezi Region, and the western and eastern basins of the Okavango river in Kavango Region have a risk of falciparum (malignant) malaria infection all year round.

lines.t: 建議前往前述風險區旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。
lines.e: Travellers going to the above risk areas are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites and to ask a doctor to assess whether oral preventive medicine is needed.

immuno.e: Some malaria prevention medicines interact with HIV medicines. The medicines currently known to interact are as follows:

immuno.t: 美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外衛滋、易伐滋可能使此藥物的效果下降。

immuno.t: 阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外可能和易伐滋產生交互作用。

immuno.e: Chloroquine: may interact with one HIV medicine (listed by its Taiwan brand name in the Chinese original).

immuno.t: 四環黴素(Doxycycline)：目前無已知交互作用。
immuno.e: Doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic): no interactions are currently known.

immuno.t: 有些瘧疾預防藥物會和HIV藥物產生交互作用，目前已知會用交互作用的藥物如下：
immuno.e: Some malaria prevention medicines interact with HIV medicines. The medicines currently known to interact are as follows:

immuno.t: 美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外衛滋、易伐滋可能使此藥物的效果下降。
immuno.e: Mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; in addition, two other HIV medicines listed there may reduce the effect of this medicine.

immuno.t: 阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外可能和易伐滋產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; it may also interact with one other HIV medicine listed there.

immuno.t: 氯奎寧(Chloroquine)：可能和諾億亞產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Chloroquine: may interact with one HIV medicine (listed by its Taiwan brand name in the Chinese original).

immuno.t: 四環黴素(Doxycycline)：目前無已知交互作用。
immuno.e: Doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic): no interactions are currently known.

longstay.t: 居住於瘧疾高風險地區者，一般建議全程服用瘧疾預防藥物，如當地流行趨勢明顯，可與醫師討論僅於流行季節期間服用藥物。依目前用藥研究，美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)、阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)、四環黴素(Doxycycline)長期使用均不影響用藥效果，但請先諮詢醫師；但長期使用氯奎寧(chloroquine)，累積用量達100 g (約累計使用5年)可能造成視網膜毒性，應特別留意。
longstay.e: People who live in high-risk malaria areas are generally recommended to take malaria prevention medicine throughout; if the local epidemic trend is clear, they can discuss with a doctor taking the medicine only during the epidemic season. According to current research on the medicines, long-term use of mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione), atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone) and doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic) does not affect how well they work, but consult a doctor first. However, long-term use of chloroquine, with a cumulative dose of 100 g (about 5 years of use in total), may cause retinal toxicity, so take particular care.

longstay.t: 因孕婦、嬰幼兒的瘧疾預防用藥選擇有限，如計劃於居留當地期間受孕，請先諮詢醫師相關風險及預防方式。
longstay.e: Because the choice of malaria prevention medicine for pregnant women and infants and young children is limited, if you plan to conceive while staying there, consult a doctor first about the risks and ways of prevention.

lines.t: 全境且全年皆有感染熱帶瘧(惡性瘧)風險，尤其中部、南部地區感染風險較高，北部地區風險較低且為季節性流行，紅海沿岸地區感染風險極低。

pregnancy.t: 孕婦感染瘧疾發生嚴重併發症機率較高，可選擇的瘧疾預防藥物也比較有限，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議。

pregnancy.t: 如果沒有適合的藥物可使用，建議暫緩前往高風險區。

pregnancy.e: Pregnant women who get malaria are more likely to have serious complications, and the malaria prevention medicines they can choose from are also more limited. Be sure to consult a doctor early for advice on preventive medicine.

pregnancy.t: 如果沒有適合的藥物可使用，建議暫緩前往高風險區。
pregnancy.e: If there is no suitable medicine available, we recommend postponing travel to high-risk areas.

immuno.t: 有些瘧疾預防藥物會和HIV藥物產生交互作用，目前已知會用交互作用的藥物如下：
immuno.e: Some malaria prevention medicines interact with HIV medicines. The medicines currently known to interact are as follows:

immuno.t: 美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外衛滋、易伐滋可能使此藥物的效果下降。

immuno.t: 阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外可能和易伐滋產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; it may also interact with one other HIV medicine listed there.

immuno.t: 氯奎寧(Chloroquine)：可能和諾億亞產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Chloroquine: may interact with one HIV medicine (listed by its Taiwan brand name in the Chinese original).

immuno.t: 四環黴素(Doxycycline)：目前無已知交互作用。

longstay.t: 居住於瘧疾高風險地區者，一般建議全程服用瘧疾預防藥物，如當地流行趨勢明顯，可與醫師討論僅於流行季節期間服用藥物。依目前用藥研究，美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)、阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)、四環黴素(Doxycycline)長期使用均不影響用藥效果，但請先諮詢醫師；但長期使用氯奎寧(chloroquine)，累積用量達100 g (約累計使用5年)可能造成視網膜毒性，應特別留意。

According to current research on the medicines, long-term use of mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione), atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone) and doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic) does not affect how well they work, but consult a doctor first. longstay.t: 因孕婦、嬰幼兒的瘧疾預防用藥選擇有限，如計劃於居留當地期間受孕，請先諮詢醫師相關風險及預防方式。
longstay.e: Because the choice of malaria prevention medicine for pregnant women and infants and young children is limited, if you plan to conceive while staying there, consult a doctor first about the risks and ways of prevention.

lines.t: 感染風險極低。5-10月間，北部邊境地區如El Hasaka Governorate之鄉村地區可能存在間日瘧感染風險，但該國通報系統已於2010年中斷。
lines.e: The risk of infection is extremely low. From May to October, rural areas such as El Hasaka Governorate in the northern border area may have a risk of vivax malaria infection, but the country's reporting system was interrupted in 2010.

lines.t: 建議至前述風險地區旅客採取防蚊措施
lines.e: Travellers going to the above risk areas are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites

lines.t: 全年於低草原區(Low veld areas)有熱帶瘧(惡性瘧)感染風險，病例集中於 Big Bend、Mhlume、Simunye、Tshaneni地區,11月到隔年5月間風險較高。
lines.e: There is a risk of falciparum (malignant) malaria infection all year round in the Low veld areas, with cases concentrated in Big Bend, Mhlume, Simunye and Tshaneni, and the risk is higher from November to May of the following year.

lines.t: 建議前往前述風險區旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。
lines.e: Travellers going to the above risk areas are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites and to ask a doctor to assess whether oral preventive medicine is needed.

longstay.t: 因孕婦、嬰幼兒的瘧疾預防用藥選擇有限，如計劃於居留當地期間受孕，請先諮詢醫師相關風險及預防方式。
longstay.e: Because the choice of malaria prevention medicine for pregnant women and infants and young children is limited, if you plan to conceive while staying there, consult a doctor first about the risks and ways of prevention.

lines.t: 感染風險全年存於叢林、丘陵等鄉村地區，主要集中在與鄰國之邊境包含泰國最南端省分。
lines.e: There is a risk of infection all year round in rural areas such as jungle and hills, mainly concentrated along the borders with neighbouring countries, including the southernmost provinces of Thailand.

lines.t: 曼谷(Bangkok)、清邁(Chiang Mai)、芭塔雅(Pattaya)、蘇美島(Samui Island)及普吉島(Phuket Island)主要觀光區、城市地區均無感染風險。
lines.e: The main tourist areas and urban areas of Bangkok, Chiang Mai, Pattaya, Samui Island and Phuket Island have no risk of infection.

lines.t: 建議前往前述風險區旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。
lines.e: Travellers going to the above risk areas are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites and to ask a doctor to assess whether oral preventive medicine is needed.

lines.t: 瘧原蟲抗藥性：
lines.e: Malaria parasite drug resistance:

lines.t: 鄰近柬埔寨及緬甸邊境區域之熱帶瘧(惡性瘧)瘧原蟲有mefloquine以及quinine抗藥性。
lines.e: In areas near the Cambodian and Myanmar borders, falciparum (malignant) malaria parasites are resistant to mefloquine and quinine.

lines.t: 鄰近緬甸邊境區域有artemisinin抗藥性報告。
lines.e: Artemisinin resistance has been reported in areas near the Myanmar border.

lines.t: 有間日瘧瘧原蟲對chloroquine具抗藥性報告。
lines.e: Vivax malaria parasites resistant to chloroquine have been reported.

lines.t: 有諾氏瘧原蟲(P. knowlesi)感染報告。
lines.e: Infection with Plasmodium knowlesi (P. knowlesi) has been reported.

infants.t: 瘧疾預防用藥均需依照體重調整劑量，有些藥物有年齡或體重限制，不適合嬰幼兒使用，建議諮詢旅遊醫學門診醫師。
infants.e: The dose of all malaria prevention medicines must be adjusted by body weight, and some medicines have age or weight limits and are not suitable for infants and young children. We recommend consulting a travel medicine clinic doctor.

pregnancy.t: 孕婦感染瘧疾發生嚴重併發症機率較高，可選擇的瘧疾預防藥物也比較有限，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議。
pregnancy.e: Pregnant women who get malaria are more likely to have serious complications, and the malaria prevention medicines they can choose from are also more limited. Be sure to consult a doctor early for advice on preventive medicine.

pregnancy.t: 如果沒有適合的藥物可使用，建議暫緩前往高風險區。
pregnancy.e: If there is no suitable medicine available, we recommend postponing travel to high-risk areas.

lines.t: 自2009年起無熱帶瘧(惡性瘧)本土病例通報，自2015年起無間日瘧本土病例通報；以往於6月到10月間有間日瘧感染風險，尤其是在下列地區：南部區域(Khatlon Region)、部分中部區域(Dushanbe)、西部區域(Gorno-Badakhshan Autonomous Region)以及北部區域(Leninabad Region)。
lines.e: No local cases of falciparum (malignant) malaria have been reported since 2009, and no local cases of vivax malaria since 2015; in the past there was a risk of vivax malaria infection from June to October, especially in the following areas: the southern region (Khatlon Region), part of the central region (Dushanbe), the western region (Gorno-Badakhshan Autonomous Region) and the northern region (Leninabad Region).

lines.t: 全境海拔1800公尺以下地區全年有感染熱帶瘧(惡性瘧)風險。

lines.t: 高風險區如下：
lines.e: The high-risk areas are as follows:

lines.t: 北緯18度海拔1500公尺以下之高原地區為高風險區，尤其於中部高原四個省分—多樂省(Dak Lak)、得農省(Dak Nong)、嘉萊省(Gia Lai)以及崑嵩省(Kon Tum)。
lines.e: Highland areas below 1500 metres above sea level at latitude 18 degrees north are high-risk areas, especially the four central highland provinces of Dak Lak, Dak Nong, Gia Lai and Kon Tum.

lines.t: 平福省(Binh Phuoc)以及慶和省(Khanh Hoa)、寧順省(Ninh Thuan)、廣南省(Quang Nam)以及廣志省(Quang Tri)等沿海省分之西部地區。
lines.e: The western parts of Binh Phuoc and of coastal provinces such as Khanh Hoa, Ninh Thuan, Quang Nam and Quang Tri.

lines.t: 建議前往前述風險區旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。
lines.e: Travellers going to the above risk areas are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites and to ask a doctor to assess whether oral preventive medicine is needed.

lines.t: 氯奎寧(chloroquine)與美爾奎寧(mefloquine)抗藥性。
lines.e: Resistance to chloroquine and mefloquine.

infants.t: 幼兒感染瘧疾可能會有嚴重併發症，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議，並採取適當防蚊措施。
infants.e: Malaria in young children may cause serious complications. Be sure to consult a doctor early for advice on preventive medicine, and take suitable measures against mosquito bites.

infants.t: 瘧疾預防用藥均需依照體重調整劑量，有些藥物有年齡或體重限制，不適合嬰幼兒使用，建議諮詢旅遊醫學門診醫師。
infants.e: The dose of all malaria prevention medicines must be adjusted by body weight, and some medicines have age or weight limits and are not suitable for infants and young children. We recommend consulting a travel medicine clinic doctor.

pregnancy.t: 孕婦感染瘧疾發生嚴重併發症機率較高，可選擇的瘧疾預防藥物也比較有限，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議。
pregnancy.e: Pregnant women who get malaria are more likely to have serious complications, and the malaria prevention medicines they can choose from are also more limited. Be sure to consult a doctor early for advice on preventive medicine.

pregnancy.t: 如果沒有適合的藥物可使用，建議暫緩前往高風險區。
pregnancy.e: If there is no suitable medicine available, we recommend postponing travel to high-risk areas.

immuno.t: 有些瘧疾預防藥物會和HIV藥物產生交互作用，目前已知會用交互作用的藥物如下：
immuno.e: Some malaria prevention medicines interact with HIV medicines. The medicines currently known to interact are as follows:

immuno.t: 美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外衛滋、易伐滋可能使此藥物的效果下降。
immuno.e: Mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; in addition, two other HIV medicines listed there may reduce the effect of this medicine.

immuno.t: 阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外可能和易伐滋產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; it may also interact with one other HIV medicine listed there.

immuno.t: 氯奎寧(Chloroquine)：可能和諾億亞產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Chloroquine: may interact with one HIV medicine (listed by its Taiwan brand name in the Chinese original).

immuno.t: 四環黴素(Doxycycline)：目前無已知交互作用。
immuno.e: Doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic): no interactions are currently known.

longstay.t: 居住於瘧疾高風險地區者，一般建議全程服用瘧疾預防藥物，如當地流行趨勢明顯，可與醫師討論僅於流行季節期間服用藥物。依目前用藥研究，美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)、阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)、四環黴素(Doxycycline)長期使用均不影響用藥效果，但請先諮詢醫師；但長期使用氯奎寧(chloroquine)，累積用量達100 g (約累計使用5年)可能造成視網膜毒性，應特別留意。
longstay.e: People who live in high-risk malaria areas are generally recommended to take malaria prevention medicine throughout; if the local epidemic trend is clear, they can discuss with a doctor taking the medicine only during the epidemic season. According to current research on the medicines, long-term use of mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione), atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone) and doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic) does not affect how well they work, but consult a doctor first. However, long-term use of chloroquine, with a cumulative dose of 100 g (about 5 years of use in total), may cause retinal toxicity, so take particular care.

longstay.t: 因孕婦、嬰幼兒的瘧疾預防用藥選擇有限，如計劃於居留當地期間受孕，請先諮詢醫師相關風險及預防方式。
longstay.e: Because the choice of malaria prevention medicine for pregnant women and infants and young children is limited, if you plan to conceive while staying there, consult a doctor first about the risks and ways of prevention.

lines.t: 全境大部分地區皆有低度至中度的間日瘧感染風險，熱帶瘧(惡性瘧)仍存在感染風險。
lines.e: Most areas throughout the country have a low to moderate risk of vivax malaria infection, and there is still a risk of falciparum (malignant) malaria infection.

lines.t: 建議旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。
lines.e: Travellers are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites and to ask a doctor to assess whether oral preventive medicine is needed.

lines.t: 氯奎寧(chloroquine)，,已有間日瘧瘧原蟲對chloroquine具抗藥性報告。
lines.e: Chloroquine, with chloroquine resistance reported in vivax malaria parasites.

infants.t: 幼兒感染瘧疾可能會有嚴重併發症，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議，並採取適當防蚊措施。
infants.e: Malaria in young children may cause serious complications. Be sure to consult a doctor early for advice on preventive medicine, and take suitable measures against mosquito bites.

infants.t: 瘧疾預防用藥均需依照體重調整劑量，有些藥物有年齡或體重限制，不適合嬰幼兒使用，建議諮詢旅遊醫學門診醫師。
infants.e: The dose of all malaria prevention medicines must be adjusted by body weight, and some medicines have age or weight limits and are not suitable for infants and young children. We recommend consulting a travel medicine clinic doctor.

pregnancy.t: 孕婦感染瘧疾發生嚴重併發症機率較高，可選擇的瘧疾預防藥物也比較有限，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議。
pregnancy.e: Pregnant women who get malaria are more likely to have serious complications, and the malaria prevention medicines they can choose from are also more limited. Be sure to consult a doctor early for advice on preventive medicine.

pregnancy.t: 如果沒有適合的藥物可使用，建議暫緩前往高風險區。
pregnancy.e: If there is no suitable medicine available, we recommend postponing travel to high-risk areas.

immuno.t: 有些瘧疾預防藥物會和HIV藥物產生交互作用，目前已知會用交互作用的藥物如下：
immuno.e: Some malaria prevention medicines interact with HIV medicines. The medicines currently known to interact are as follows:

immuno.t: 美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外衛滋、易伐滋可能使此藥物的效果下降。
immuno.e: Mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; in addition, two other HIV medicines listed there may reduce the effect of this medicine.

immuno.t: 阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，包含快利佳、諾億亞、瑞塔茲、普利他、捷伏茲、克濾滿；另外可能和易伐滋產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; it may also interact with one other HIV medicine listed there.

immuno.t: 氯奎寧(Chloroquine)：可能和諾億亞產生交互作用。
immuno.e: Chloroquine: may interact with one HIV medicine (listed by its Taiwan brand name in the Chinese original).

immuno.t: 四環黴素(Doxycycline)：目前無已知交互作用。
immuno.e: Doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic): no interactions are currently known.

longstay.t: 居住於瘧疾高風險地區者，一般建議全程服用瘧疾預防藥物，如當地流行趨勢明顯，可與醫師討論僅於流行季節期間服用藥物。依目前用藥研究，美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)、阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)、四環黴素(Doxycycline)長期使用均不影響用藥效果，但請先諮詢醫師；但長期使用氯奎寧(chloroquine)，累積用量達100 g (約累計使用5年)可能造成視網膜毒性，應特別留意。
longstay.e: People who live in high-risk malaria areas are generally recommended to take malaria prevention medicine throughout; if the local epidemic trend is clear, they can discuss with a doctor taking the medicine only during the epidemic season. According to current research on the medicines, long-term use of mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione), atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone) and doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic) does not affect how well they work, but consult a doctor first. However, long-term use of chloroquine, with a cumulative dose of 100 g (about 5 years of use in total), may cause retinal toxicity, so take particular care.

longstay.t: 因孕婦、嬰幼兒的瘧疾預防用藥選擇有限，如計劃於居留當地期間受孕，請先諮詢醫師相關風險及預防方式。
longstay.e: Because the choice of malaria prevention medicine for pregnant women and infants and young children is limited, if you plan to conceive while staying there, consult a doctor first about the risks and ways of prevention.

lines.t: 全境且全年皆有熱帶瘧(惡性瘧)感染風險。
lines.e: There is a risk of falciparum (malignant) malaria throughout the country all year round.

lines.t: 建議旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。
lines.e: Travellers are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites and to ask a doctor to assess whether oral preventive medicine is needed.

notes.MY: Malaysia has a significant number of indigenous malaria cases caused by Plasmodium knowlesi infection; zero indigenous cases of human Plasmodium species for the seventh consecutive year in 2024.
notes.SA: Zero indigenous cases for the fourth consecutive year in 2024.
notes.BT: Zero indigenous cases for the third consecutive year in 2024, ending the malaria epidemic.
notes.SY: Not on WHO's list of countries certified malaria-free; WHO gives the Syrian Arab Republic malaria-free status (no indigenous cases since 2005). Shown in the certified colour on the WHO map image.
